tools.name: notable_search
tools.description: Search the public Dayze notable-people catalog by name, occupation, or slug. Use when you need to find a person before fetching a pack. Example slug: albert-einstein. ($0.01)

tools.name: notable_profile
tools.description: Full notable-person profile JSON by slug. Use for bio, timeline, and metadata without similar people or life-in-days context. Example slug: taylor-swift. ($0.02)

tools.name: notable_pack
tools.description: Knowledge pack: profile + life-in-days + similar people + birthday peers (+ quality / upgrade hint). Timeline events include day_number. Best starting point for agent context. Example slug: albert-einstein. ($0.05)

tools.name: notable_pack_premium
tools.description: S-tier guaranteed pack (score≥85, timeline≥8, image, embedding). Errors if below bar. Use when you need high-quality, complete notable context. Example slug: elon-musk. ($0.10)

tools.name: get_life_context
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's current life context — identity, today's events, mood, inner circle, and social edges. Prefer get_context_pack for a full session bootstrap. Requires API key. ($0.15; API key required)

tools.name: get_context_pack
tools.description: Life Context Protocol (LCP) reference pack for a Dayze user: identity + who matters (edges) + week calendar + semantic/recent memories. Includes protocol.version. Optional query focuses memories. Requires API key or share token. Spec: https://dayze.com/docs/life-context ($0.20; API key required)

tools.name: get_life_graph
tools.description: Life-graph export: people nodes + person_connections edges. Optional event–people links. Requires API key. ($0.25; API key required)

tools.name: get_person_neighborhood
tools.description: Subgraph around one person_id — profile plus all declared connections. Requires API key. ($0.15; API key required)

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: User calendar events (range: today|week|month|year|decade). Requires API key. ($0.10; API key required)

tools.name: get_people
tools.description: List user CRM people (flat list). Each row includes contact_origin (personal|online|imported). Requires API key. ($0.10; API key required)

tools.name: get_memories
tools.description: User memories from Dayze Agent. Pass query for semantic retrieval; omit for recent chronological. Requires API key. ($0.10; API key required)

tools.name: get_expenses
tools.description: List user expenses / cashflow summary. Requires API key. ($0.10; API key required)

tools.name: get_trackers
tools.description: List user trackers / habits / streaks. Requires API key. ($0.10; API key required)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic search across the authenticated user life graph (events, people, memories). Requires API key. ($0.15; API key required)

labels.name: update_food
labels.description: MUTATES one existing Food Diary row the authenticated user owns. Required: food_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_food): what, kind, place, merchant, notes, consumed_at / meal_period, amount, currency, paid_by, with / people_names / person_ids. Example: add hot tea onto an existing Salmo

labels.name: delete_food
labels.description: MUTATES by removing one Food Diary row the authenticated user owns and its mirrored calendar event. Required: food_id (UUID). Prefer this over delete_event for meals logged via log_food. Unknown or other-user food_id returns an error. Rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context

labels.name: log_event
labels.description: MUTATES the authenticated user calendar. Use for non-food days — funeral, cremation, appointment, dinner, anything that is not a food log. Do not store this as a chat memory. labels.name: update_event
labels.description: MUTATES one existing calendar event the authenticated user owns. Required: event_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_event): title, date / event_date, time / event_time, end_date, end_time, location, description, category, external_url, people / with / person_ids. Unknown or other-user eve

labels.name: delete_event
labels.description: MUTATES by removing one existing calendar event the authenticated user owns. Required: event_id (UUID). Unknown or other-user event_id returns an error. event_people tags cascade; linked entity_assets are archived. When the event mirrors a Food Diary row (external_source user_food_log), the food row

labels.name: log_favorite_song
labels.description: MUTATES the authenticated user favorite tracks list at /music. Use when they favorite or save a song — do not store this as a chat memory or in music_preferences. Example: “Henry Mancini - Piano And Strings (1995 Remastered)” → log_favorite_song({ track: "Henry Mancini - Piano And Strings (1995 Rema

labels.name: get_memories
labels.description: Authenticated user memories from Dayze Agent. Pass query for semantic/keyword retrieval. Prefer search for event-first trip and calendar titles. Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_expenses
labels.description: Authenticated user cashflow summary: spend, income, net, and top spend categories. Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: resolve_person
labels.description: Resolve a nickname or surface name to a CRM person via person_aliases → exact name → slug → unique substring. Returns avatar_url, photo_count, has_photos, and photos[{url,is_primary}] preview; use get_person_photos for full gallery. Notes omitted unless include_notes=true (redacted). Prefer this bef

labels.name: get_person_aliases
labels.description: List canonical aliases (nicknames) for a CRM person. Pass person_id or name (resolved via aliases). Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: get_person_transactions
labels.description: Me↔contact money ledger from expenses (paid_to_person_id / income_from_person_id). Pass person_id or name. Returns entries + per-currency totals. Reuses existing expenses — no parallel ledger table. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_money_between_people
labels.description: Same as get_person_transactions: authenticated user ↔ one contact via expenses FKs. Prefer get_person_transactions; this alias exists for agent discoverability. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_person_interactions
labels.description: Relationship timeline for one CRM person: interactions rows (message/call/meeting/note + extended kinds like visit/gift/stayed_over encoded in summary) plus co-tagged calendar events. Prefer this over dumping people.notes for “when did I last see X?”. Pass person_id or name. ($0.10; API key required

labels.name: explain_fact
labels.description: Return evidence/provenance for a claim: polaris_learned_facts, life_events / life_event_relationships when present, then memories. Use when the agent must cite why it believes something — do not invent sources. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: list_clarifications
labels.description: Ranked clarification queue: only person-typed mentions + duplicate CRM people. Non-person junk (places, orgs, media, command fragments) is auto-dismissed. Existing contacts auto-link. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: get_trackers
labels.description: Authenticated user live trackers only; expired countdowns and inactive streaks are omitted. Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: search
labels.description: Search the authenticated user life graph. Deterministic routing first: food + relative dates (e.g. "what did I eat yesterday?"); timeline/current-context; money+person; who-is → resolve_person. Otherwise semantic/keyword search. Event hits include event_date and food_id when mirrored from Food Diary

labels.name: search_gmail
labels.description: Search the authenticated user's already-connected Gmail inbox (read-only). Reuses the Dayze Integrations hub Gmail connection (service_connections provider=gmail, scope gmail.readonly) — no new OAuth vendor. Prefer Gmail operators: from:, subject:, is:unread, newer_than:7d, has:attachment. Returns i

labels.name: read_gmail_message
labels.description: Read one Gmail message by id from search_gmail. Returns subject, from, date, snippet, and plain-text body (truncated). Reuses the Integrations hub Gmail connection. Read-only — cannot send, archive, or delete. Never invent body text. If Gmail is not connected, connect at /integrations. Requires API

labels.name: log_sleep
labels.description: Sleep: log overnight or nap. Cross-midnight OK (e.g. 14:00→03:00 = 13h / 780m). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_sleep
labels.description: Sleep: list typed sleep/nap records with duration_minutes. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: get_sleep_summary
labels.description: Sleep: day/week/month totals and averages. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: update_sleep
labels.description: Sleep: patch an existing sleep record by sleep_id. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: resolve_place
labels.description: Canonicalize a venue name via place aliases and fuzzy match. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_places
labels.description: Known canonical places in the user Life Graph. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_place_visits
labels.description: When was I at a venue — merges place_visits, location_visits, and event locations. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_location_history
labels.description: Normalized visit history (venue-level by default, not raw GPS noise). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_location_context
labels.description: Likely current or at-time place with confidence and provenance. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_trips
labels.description: User trips with status filter (planned/completed/etc.). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_trip
labels.description: Single trip with linked places and people. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_travel_history
labels.description: Completed/confirmed travel only. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_countries_visited
labels.description: Canonical countries from completed trips (not other people travel). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_cities_visited
labels.description: Canonical cities from completed trips. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: create_person
labels.description: Add a CRM contact; checks duplicates first. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: merge_people
labels.description: Merge duplicate CRM contacts into a primary person. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: score_people_duplicates
labels.description: Score likely CRM duplicate pairs before merge_people. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: link_people
labels.description: Create person↔person graph edge (knows/friends/…). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_person_connections
labels.description: List graph edges for one CRM person. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: unlink_people
labels.description: Remove a person↔person graph edge. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: dismiss_clarification
labels.description: Dismiss a pending entity clarification (not_person, etc.). ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: resolve_clarification
labels.description: Link a clarification surface to an existing person. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: bulk_dismiss_clarifications
labels.description: Dismiss non-person / typed junk from the clarification queue. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: link_entities
labels.description: Link Trip→Stay→Place / Event→Person (graph, not prose). ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_entity_links
labels.description: List graph edges for an event, trip, place, or person. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: add_inventory_item
labels.description: Add an owned object to Life Inventory. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_inventory
labels.description: Browse owned inventory with filters. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_inventory_item
labels.description: Full item with valuations, people links, assets. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: update_inventory_item
labels.description: PATCH semantics — unspecified fields untouched. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: archive_inventory_item
labels.description: Archive instead of destructive delete. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: search_inventory
labels.description: Structured + keyword search over owned objects. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: add_inventory_valuation
labels.description: Append immutable valuation observation. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_inventory_valuations
labels.description: Chronological valuation history for an item. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: link_inventory_person
labels.description: Provenance link e.g. inherited_from, gifted_by. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: upload_asset
labels.description: Upload image bytes to Dayze storage (WebP re-encode strips EXIF/AI metadata). Returns asset_id. For inventory item photos: pass entity_type=inventory, entity_id=inventory_id, role=photo, image_base64 from chat images. Or upload then attach_asset. ($0.15; API key required)

labels.name: get_asset
labels.description: Fetch one asset by asset_id with signed_url for download/processing. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: update_asset
labels.description: Patch role, metadata, description, or parent_asset_id (e.g. mark as processed). ($0.08; API key required)

labels.name: archive_asset
labels.description: Soft-delete an asset (sets archived_at). Original rows are preserved for versioning. ($0.05; API key required)

labels.name: upload_photo
labels.description: Upload a photo to a Life Graph entity. Accepts image_base64 or url (one required). Re-encodes via WebP (strips EXIF/AI metadata). Person uploads also write the CRM gallery (person_photos) and avatar when set_as_avatar=true. ($0.15; API key required)

labels.name: attach_asset
labels.description: Link an existing asset_id to another entity by creating a linked copy (does not move the original row). Roles: original | processed | thumbnail | cover | document | receipt | certificate | other. Legacy: pass url instead of asset_id. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_entity_assets
labels.description: List assets linked to an entity (role, signed_url, versions). entity_type inventory_item → inventory. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: log_expense
labels.description: Create an outgoing expense only. For money received (Venmo/Cash App/PayPal/Zelle) use log_transaction with direction=from and type=income. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: log_transaction
labels.description: Income/expense/transfer write. direction=from + type=income for Venmo received. Positive amount; external_id dedupes imports. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: update_expense
labels.description: PATCH an expense row. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: record_purchase
labels.description: Atomic expense + optional inventory item creation. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: record_sale
labels.description: Mark inventory sold + record sale proceeds with gain/loss. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_transactions
labels.description: List expense/income/transfer rows. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: search_transactions
labels.description: Keyword search over transactions. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: search_photos
labels.description: Search person photos and entity assets by query/metadata. Returns inline MCP image attachments. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_photo
labels.description: Single photo metadata + secure URL. Returns inline MCP image attachment when available. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_photos_for_event
labels.description: Assets linked to an event. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_person_photos
labels.description: Gallery image URLs for a CRM contact. Returns photos[{ id, url, is_primary, created_at }] plus inline MCP image attachments for chat render. Accepts person_id. ($0.10; API key required)

labels.name: get_photos_for_place
labels.description: Assets linked to a canonical place. ($0.10; API key required)
